notes.title: Ground Control Update
notes.notes:
The latest (v1.1.3) update enhances visual and performance aspects, including better shadows, higher texture resolution, improved visuals on asteroid sections of launch and landing stations, and minor UI improvements.

[b]Highlights:[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Improved shadow quality[/b] for all game shadows and in particularly noticeable locations such as the landing station.
[*] [b]Improved visual quality[/b] on the asteroid portion of the launch and landing stations for improved fidelity.
[*] [b]Increased texture resolution[/b] on all assets for consistent 4k across all texture sets.
[*] [b]Thruster colour[/b] on all pods now matches their cosmetic skin for improved visual interest.
[*] [b]Minor UI updates[/b] to resolve a few layout issues for ultra-widescreen displays.
[*] [b]Minor performance improvements[/b] to squeeze out a few extra FPS on some hardware.
[/list]

notes.title: Flight Dynamics Update
notes.notes:
Prepare your pods for descent pilots! Descent Vector is dropping with new updates focused on fixing bugs and squeezing out extra FPS so nothing stands between you and your elite-piloting skills.

[b]New Features:[/b]

[olist]
[*]Added new optimizations to improve overall performance on resource limited hardware. You'll see a minor adjustment to the length of each mission due to these changes.
[*]Adjusted lighting slightly for improved visibility on small screens such as the Steam Deck.
[*]Added an icon to show when the game is saving data.
[/olist]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

A big thank you goes to the great people on [url=https://discord.gg/heavypepper]Descent Vector's Discord Community[/url] who reported these bugs. Your input and testing is greatly appreciated.

[olist]
[*]Fixed a bug where it was possible to travel indefinitely under certain circumstances.
[*]Fixed a navigation issue within the menu when using keyboard or controller only input.
[*]Tweaked a few UI visuals for Ultrawide (21:10) screens.
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40202737/bb0d46bb6fa6cc6f3edb2ad99fc1b788b36f338a.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Expanding Horizons Update Patch
notes.notes:
With the latest large content update comes this minor follow-up patch. This patch addresses a few bugs and includes a few small changes.

[u]Please note[/u] that this patch will overwrite your settings in Options. You may want to double-check that everything is configured the way you wish.

[b]New Feature:[/b]

[olist]
[*]It's now easier to see when your Phase Shield is about to run out. It will transition from a pink, to orange, then flash blue once it wears off. A sound cue will also occur.
[/olist]
[b]Minor Updates & Bug Fixes:[/b]

[olist]
[*]Leaderboard loading issues on Mac have been resolved.
[*]Leaderboard skull icons are now a little smaller and out of the way.
[*]New lighting in dark spaces helps illuminate some hard to see obstacles.
[*]There is a new option to disable camera shake if desired.
[*]Fixed a bug where the pause menu could be activated on a loading screen.
[*]Space planes and rockets are better positioned in the play area when you're at high distances from the launch point.
[*]Fixed a small bug where phase shield effect wouldn't display in some situations.
[*]Using phase shield through an asteroid will no longer "bump" the asteroid slightly.
[/olist]

notes.title: The Expanding Horizons Update has Landed
notes.notes:
Hello pilots!

[b]The Expanding Horizons update is now live![/b]

Here are the major new features you can expect from this [b]Expanding Horizons update[/b].

[list]
[*] New Environments
[*] Mining Lasers, Megastructures and New Content
[*] New Pick-up Mechanic
[*] Damage Mechanic Overhaul
[*] Leaderboard Overhaul
[*] Richer Sound Scape
[/list]

[h2]New Environments[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40202737/459d3f0992f88a684a8d58bd51091e49fc5721e1.jpg[/img]

Three new environments are now available, each offering a unique atmosphere and mood plus increasing difficulty as you progress. The first, Betelgeuse, puts you in the vicinity of an unstable supergiant star and bathes you in yellow orange light. Trappist-1C, a desert wasteland planet includes a large population of dusty orbiting asteroids. Finally we have an ice ringed planet in orbit of the massive black hole Cygnus X-1. Each new environment comes with new pod skins and achievements to unlock.

[h2]Mining Lasers, Megastructures and New Content[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40202737/f623c60b42c92817df3430c883405e5b15e296d8.jpg[/img]

New to this update are added obstacle types, and with procedurally generated levels, the new obstacles provide unique piloting situations to challenge your skills.

You’ll encounter industrial mega structures which span the play area and segments which block half of your route. You’ll need to make split second decisions to navigate these hazards or suffer catastrophic failure upon impact. 

Operating in space means items need to get into orbit. Watch out for the new heavy lifting rocket addition which ejects its payload fairings creating multiple threats. You’ll also encounter new space craft which perform roll maneuvers presenting a new danger.

Space based industry is hard at work and mining craft are busy blasting minerals off of asteroids with powerful lasers. Try not to intersect a laser beam with your pod as this will void your pod’s warranty.

These new hazards now spin in random directions at random speeds. This makes each encounter unique so you’ll need to assess each situation and decide how best to navigate the hazard.

[h2]New Pick-up Mechanic[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40202737/ac097763f3242c5d41f31519b8ff691cd3748037.jpg[/img]

The Expanding Horizons update now includes pick-ups which adjust the behaviour of your space pod. There are three types, a shield which will phase shift your pod out of normal space allowing you to pass through solid objects. A retro rocket pick-up which will slow your pod by a percentage for a period of time and a repair pick-up with nanobots to put out fires and to fix up any unsightly scratches.

[h2]Damage Mechanic Overhaul[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40202737/e3a14b10fc6082cfa6a082f18613900ba680e2b7.jpg[/img]

On the subject of damage, this mechanic has been overhauled. You’re free to crash through as many solar panels as you desire but beware, this causes damage, as does just grazing other objects. You’ll want to keep an eye on your hull integrity and seek out repair pick-ups whenever needed.

[h2]Leaderboard Overhaul[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40202737/05dff353a6b001c75b26a23df408ba722dba98b7.jpg[/img]

Descent Vector is as much about competing against the global leaderboards as it is navigating your way through hazardous space. With this new update comes new leaderboards, one for each mission environment. In endless mode you can see when you pass players near your level as their visual markers are now visible in-game. At the end of each endless mission you can now see your standing in the leaderboards without returning to the main menu.

[h2]Richer Sound Scape[/h2]

To add to your experience you’ll find navigating through space is a much richer experience with the addition of new environmental sounds. Space stations, industrial structures, mining lasers, and other objects all have their own sounds creating a rich auditory environment and a more full feeling experience.

[h2]One More Thing...[/h2]

Finally for this update the HUD has been reworked so you can better visualize damage, speed, and distance to landing. The menu is now easier to use, especially for controller users, and the PS5 DualSense controller is now officially supported along with the PS4 and XBox controllers.

[previewyoutube=ChEo0nKdWtg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Final Thoughts[/h2]

We’re extremely excited to get these new features in your hands and can’t wait to see your new scores on the leaderboards.

If you haven’t already, join the discussion on the Steam community hub, share your screenshots, and thoughts. Follow us on Twitter or join our official discord to meet other space pod pilots and chat with the dev.

notes.title: PS4 DualShock Controller Support Added.
notes.notes:
PS4 DualShock controller support has been added. Please note that the controller may try and route audio through its internal speaker. If so, please adjust your sound settings back to your preferred output device.

Unfortunately PS5 DualSense controllers are not supported at this time. You may experience weird behaviour if this controller is connected while playing. Unity, the game engine behind Descent Vector does not yet support that device. As soon as support is offered an update will be provided.

Thank you for playing!

notes.title: Descent Vector Update #3
notes.notes:
Hello Pilots!

As Descent Vector closes in on launch day the final touches and polish are being added to the game. In this update you’ll find…

[list]
[*]New features
[*]New environments
[*]Patches
[/list]

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[h3]Steam Features[/h3]

Descent Vector now features cloud saves and 17 achievements. Plus you can compete against your friends and global players on the leaderboards for best distance.

[h3]Unlocks and Cards[/h3]

New space pods have been added which unlock as you progress. Gaining achievements also unlocks in-game cards to add to your collection.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40202737/6ad3ccd64e1c86ac881685bfaf0b66f4f73ff48f.jpg[/img]


[h2]New Space Environments[/h2]

Descent Vector ships with four space environments with two new ones added... 

[h3]Tau Ceti F[/h3]

The Tau Ceti system hosts a super-earth sized planet dominated by a blanket of low-lying vegetation and simple animal life. It may be facing a mass extinction event as a recent cataclysm has fractured its moon sending debris crashing into the planet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40202737/e990423855eb15ca09d83566063ecce4740d903b.jpg[/img]

[h3]51 Pegasi B[/h3]

When travelling to 51 Pegasi B the immense gas giant dominates your view. Composed mostly of an ammonium hydrosulfide atmosphere this toxic brew is quite inhospitable. Look a little closer and of the many moons in orbit one stands out as special. This ringed moon does sustain life and is home to a thriving colony.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40202737/80663eda76291012c0153f9e0ee8f05f658b0209.jpg[/img]


[h2]Patches[/h2]

[list]
[*] Invisible walls have been removed and it's now possible to fly between a space arm without crashing. You can also fly much closer and graze structures without destruction.
[*] Optimization improvements add a more consistent FPS throughout.
[*] Improved gamepad and analog thumbstick controls.
[/list]

notes.title: Let's Play Descent Vector: Space Runner (Re-Broadcast of Friday's Event)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40202737/927f2a8b6d96e0fcbeb053780ab1b47497e96777.jpg[/img]

[h2]HIGH-SPEED SCI-FI ENDLESS RUNNER[/h2]

Descent Vector: Space Runner is about dodging a column of space stations, asteroids, and debris at high-speed from the third person perspective of piloting a space pod. Relying on focus and twitch reflexes to navigate, Descent Vector challenges you to survive the gauntlet and break your previous best distance.

Descent Vector adds 3D sci-fi visuals to the endless runner genre and highlights reckless flying with glorious explosions and waves of crashing destruction. Buckle-up and take control of your space pod. You'll either survive the gauntlet or go out in an adrenaline fuelled blaze of high-speed glory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40202737/ef2227568071bb6ec1fa90075931942e6b95702b.jpg[/img]

[h3]DIFFERENT EVERY TIME[/h3]
Each play-through is unique with procedurally generated space stations and random placement of asteroids, booster rockets and space-age dangers.

[h3]DESTRUCTIBLE CHAOS[/h3]
Destructible environments react to your crashes, exploding from the point of impact and cascading in unique waves of destruction.

[h3]CAMPAIGN & ENDLESS MODES[/h3]
Progress through increasingly difficult courses in campaign mode and compete against your previous best distance in endless mode.

[h3]VISIT ALIEN EXOPLANETS[/h3]
Each mission takes you to a sci-fi environment inspired by the latest available knowledge astronomers have on real exoplanets.

[h3]UNLOCKABLES[/h3]
Unlock campaign missions, endless mode, space pod cosmetic skins, and achievements as you progress.

[h3]CONTROLLER SUPPORT[/h3]
Descent Vector supports keyboard and mouse control along with natural feeling full controller support.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40202737/fea2e7c9589f8817e23d9f6ee4b566397fb0c91d.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Descent Vector Dev Update #2
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=N4NiemYCrcI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Welcome to Gliese 436 B pilot![/h1]

Gliese 436 B is a frozen ice world where cryovolcanoes spew ammonia ice into space from subsurface oceans. In orbit the ice collects into an immense and beautiful ring around the planet. Take in the view but don’t let its beauty fool you, this is a dangerous region of space! As a space pod pilot you must avoid impacting the ice rings and steer clear of collisions with the many space stations in orbit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40202737/b2998f8c73d14fe1cb6f3f0c9a63598b64601bff.jpg[/img]

[h2]Descent Vector Dev Update #2[/h2]

Descent Vector is moving forward and this update features a new mission location and environmental art.

[h2]Environment Art[/h2]

The previous update covered the lava world (Kepler 10-B) mission with a fiery planet, iron rich asteroids, and a predominantly red colour palette. The new frozen Gliese 436 B mission is complete and with it comes changes to add variety into the mission levels. 

The dark iron-rich asteroid models see an update to solid frozen chunks of ice. These are not soft snowballs and Impacting one with your space pod is equally as fatal!

Overall lighting also sees a shift with more blue hues and the introduction of a cool frosty colour palette.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40202737/927f2a8b6d96e0fcbeb053780ab1b47497e96777.jpg[/img]

[h2]What's Next?[/h2]

Two new environments are in development and waiting on final finishing touches. One features a fractured moon on orbit of a larger planet, while the other mission centres around a massive gas giant. More details on those missions in the next update!

Descent Vector will be releasing Summer 2021.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40202737/f6f955eb28f987f9d3b6b498cb248ec18bdb1a55.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Descent Vector Dev Update #1
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=u-XEYqsmbro;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Welcome to Kepler-10b pilot! [/h1]

This is a lava world bathed in solar radiation where the daytime temperatures reach 1,400°C! The planet’s crust of silicates and iron boil on a molten ever changing surface. You wouldn’t want to step foot on this planet but the asteroids in orbit are rich in iron and valuable minerals.

[h2]Descent Vector Dev Update #1[/h2]

Descent Vector is moving forward and this update is jam-packed with new visual updates!

[h2]Skybox, Asteroids, and Lighting[/h2]

The skybox for the Kepler-10b level is complete and features a molten lava world at its centre with a red and purple emission nebula to set the mood in the background. With this comes reflection and lighting updates both brightening up the level and creating correct reflection shading for the environment.

Iron rich asteroids blanket the area just outside the space station corridor and they fly past as you progress through the mission. This provides a visual cue of progression through the space environment. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40202737/72c45a6764e4f731bf8a40bf3dcda7d628649ab7.jpg[/img]

[h2]Explosions and Solar Panels[/h2]

A new gameplay mechanic is now available providing a strategic option when in trouble. If in a pinch you can punch through a solar panel without being killed. You’ll take damage but it will get you out of a tight spot to keep flying. Fire and smoke effects accompany this feature and the screen glows in red on the edges for visual flare after performing this maneuver. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40202737/ef2227568071bb6ec1fa90075931942e6b95702b.jpg[/img]

[h2]Space Music[/h2]

The pumping background music for the Kepler-10b mission is now in place and featured in the above YouTube video. New ambient music has been added to the main menu with additional mission music on the way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40202737/3e8349c7890ba7c73f6b10be04cc9291acba81a9.jpg[/img]

[h2]Menu Controller Support[/h2]

Controller support is now in place on the menus to provide full support not just in gameplay but throughout the game.

[h2]Want More?[/h2]

Descent Vector will be releasing Summer 2021. Please wishlist to stay up-to-date on its development.
